+    """Split ISBN values into ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 lists by normalized length."""
+    if isinstance(isbns, str):
+        isbns = [isbns]
+    isbn_10 = []
+    isbn_13 = []

+        normalized = re.sub(r"[-\s]", "", value).strip()
+        if len(normalized) == 10 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]{9}[0-9Xx]", normalized):
+            isbn_10.append(normalized.upper())
+        elif len(normalized) == 13 and normalized.isdigit():
+            isbn_13.append(normalized)
+    return isbn_10, isbn_13

+def get_publisher_and_place(
+    publishers: str | list[str],
+) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    """Split IA publisher strings into publisher names and publication places."""
+    if isinstance(publishers, str):
+        publishers = [publishers]
+    publisher_names = []
